verses.ar: بَارِكِي يَا نَفْسِي ٱلرَّبَّ. يَارَبُّ إِلَهِي، قَدْ عَظُمْتَ جِدًّا. مَجْدًا وَجَلَالًا لَبِسْتَ.
verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
verses.web: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

verses.ar: ٱللَّابِسُ ٱلنُّورَ كَثَوْبٍ، ٱلْبَاسِطُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ كَشُقَّةٍ.
verses.kjv: Who coverest [thyself] with light as [with] a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.web: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُسَقِّفُ عَلَالِيَهُ بِٱلْمِيَاهِ. ٱلْجَاعِلُ ٱلسَّحَابَ مَرْكَبَتَهُ، ٱلْمَاشِي عَلَى أَجْنِحَةِ ٱلرِّيحِ.
verses.kjv: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
verses.web: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

verses.ar: ٱلصَّانِعُ مَلَائِكَتَهُ رِيَاحًا، وَخُدَّامَهُ نَارًا مُلْتَهِبَةً.
verses.kjv: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
verses.web: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُؤَسِّسُ ٱلْأَرْضَ عَلَى قَوَاعِدِهَا فَلَا تَتَزَعْزَعُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: [Who] laid the foundations of the earth, [that] it should not be removed for ever.
verses.web: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

verses.ar: كَسَوْتَهَا ٱلْغَمْرَ كَثَوْبٍ. فَوْقَ ٱلْجِبَالِ تَقِفُ ٱلْمِيَاهُ.
verses.kjv: Thou coveredst it with the deep as [with] a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.web: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

verses.ar: مِنِ ٱنْتِهَارِكَ تَهْرُبُ، مِنْ صَوْتِ رَعْدِكَ تَفِرُّ.
verses.kjv: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
verses.web: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

verses.ar: تَصْعَدُ إِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ. تَنْزِلُ إِلَى ٱلْبِقَاعِ، إِلَى ٱلْمَوْضِعِ ٱلَّذِي أَسَّسْتَهُ لَهَا.
verses.kjv: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
verses.web: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

verses.ar: وَضَعْتَ لَهَا تَخْمًا لَا تَتَعَدَّاهُ. لَا تَرْجِعُ لِتُغَطِّيَ ٱلْأَرْضَ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.web: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

verses.ar: اَلْمُفَجِّرُ عُيُونًا فِي ٱلْأَوْدِيَةِ. بَيْنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ تَجْرِي.
verses.kjv: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, [which] run among the hills.
verses.web: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

verses.ar: تَسْقِي كُلَّ حَيَوَانِ ٱلْبَرِّ. تَكْسِرُ ٱلْفِرَاءُ ظَمْأَهَا.
verses.kjv: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.web: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

verses.ar: فَوْقَهَا طُيُورُ ٱلسَّمَاءِ تَسْكُنُ. مِنْ بَيْنِ ٱلْأَغْصَانِ تُسَمِّعُ صَوْتًا.
verses.kjv: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, [which] sing among the branches.
verses.web: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

verses.ar: ٱلسَّاقِي ٱلْجِبَالَ مِنْ عَلَالِيهِ. مِنْ ثَمَرِ أَعْمَالِكَ تَشْبَعُ ٱلْأَرْضُ.
verses.kjv: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
verses.web: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُنْبِتُ عُشْبًا لِلْبَهَائِمِ، وَخُضْرَةً لِخِدْمَةِ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ، لِإِخْرَاجِ خُبْزٍ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ،
verses.kjv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.web: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

verses.ar: وَخَمْرٍ تُفَرِّحُ قَلْبَ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ، لِإِلْمَاعِ وَجْهِهِ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ ٱلزَّيْتِ، وَخُبْزٍ يُسْنِدُ قَلْبَ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ.
verses.kjv: And wine [that] maketh glad the heart of man, [and] oil to make [his] face to shine, and bread [which] strengtheneth man’s heart.
verses.web: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

verses.ar: تَشْبَعُ أَشْجَارُ ٱلرَّبِّ، أَرْزُ لُبْنَانَ ٱلَّذِي نَصَبَهُ.
verses.kjv: The trees of the LORD are full [of sap;] the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.web: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

verses.ar: حَيْثُ تُعَشِّشُ هُنَاكَ ٱلْعَصَافِيرُ. أَمَّا ٱللَّقْلَقُ فَٱلسَّرْوُ بَيْتُهُ.
verses.kjv: Where the birds make their nests: [as for] the stork, the fir trees [are] her house.
verses.web: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

verses.ar: ٱلْجِبَالُ ٱلْعَالِيَةُ لِلْوُعُولِ، ٱلصُّخُورُ مَلْجَأٌ لِلْوِبَارِ.
verses.kjv: The high hills [are] a refuge for the wild goats; [and] the rocks for the conies.
verses.web: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

verses.ar: صَنَعَ ٱلْقَمَرَ لِلْمَوَاقِيتِ. ٱلشَّمْسُ تَعْرِفُ مَغْرِبَهَا.
verses.kjv: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
verses.web: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

verses.ar: تَجْعَلُ ظُلْمَةً فَيَصِيرُ لَيْلٌ. فِيهِ يَدِبُّ كُلُّ حَيَوَانِ ٱلْوَعْرِ.
verses.kjv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep [forth].
verses.web: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

verses.ar: ٱلْأَشْبَالُ تُزَمْجِرُ لِتَخْطَفَ، وَلِتَلْتَمِسَ مِنَ ٱللهِ طَعَامَهَا.
verses.kjv: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
verses.web: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

verses.ar: تُشْرِقُ ٱلشَّمْسُ فَتَجْتَمِعُ، وَفِي مَآوِيهَا تَرْبِضُ.
verses.kjv: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.web: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

verses.ar: ٱلْإِنْسَانُ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى عَمَلِهِ، وَإِلَى شُغْلِهِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.kjv: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.web: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

verses.ar: مَا أَعْظَمَ أَعْمَالَكَ يَارَبُّ! كُلَّهَا بِحِكْمَةٍ صَنَعْتَ. مَلْآنةٌ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْ غِنَاكَ.
verses.kjv: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
verses.web: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

verses.ar: هَذَا ٱلْبَحْرُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ٱلْوَاسِعُ ٱلْأَطْرَافِ. هُنَاكَ دَبَّابَاتٌ بِلَا عَدَدٍ. صِغَارُ حَيَوَانٍ مَعَ كِبَارٍ.
verses.kjv: [So is] this great and wide sea, wherein [are] things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.web: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

verses.ar: هُنَاكَ تَجْرِي ٱلسُّفُنُ. لِوِيَاثَانُ هَذَا خَلَقْتَهُ لِيَلْعَبَ فِيهِ.
verses.kjv: There go the ships: [there is] that leviathan, [whom] thou hast made to play therein.
verses.web: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

verses.ar: كُلُّهَا إِيَّاكَ تَتَرَجَّى لِتَرْزُقَهَا قُوتَهَا فِي حِينِهِ.
verses.kjv: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give [them] their meat in due season.
verses.web: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

verses.ar: تُعْطِيهَا فَتَلْتَقِطُ. تَفْتَحُ يَدَكَ فَتَشْبَعُ خَيْرًا.
verses.kjv: [That] thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
verses.web: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

verses.ar: تَحْجُبُ وَجْهَكَ فَتَرْتَاعُ. تَنْزِعُ أَرْوَاحَهَا فَتَمُوتُ، وَإِلَى تُرَابِهَا تَعُودُ.
verses.kjv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.web: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

verses.ar: تُرْسِلُ رُوحَكَ فَتُخْلَقُ، وَتُجَدِّدُ وَجْهَ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.web: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

verses.ar: يَكُونُ مَجْدُ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. يَفْرَحُ ٱلرَّبُّ بِأَعْمَالِهِ.
verses.kjv: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
verses.web: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.

verses.ar: ٱلنَّاظِرُ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَرْتَعِدُ. يَمَسُّ ٱلْجِبَالَ فَتُدَخِّنُ.
verses.kjv: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
verses.web: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

verses.ar: أُغَنِّي لِلرَّبِّ فِي حَيَاتِي. أُرَنِّمُ لِإِلَهِي مَا دُمْتُ مَوْجُودًا.
verses.kjv: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.web: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

verses.ar: فَيَلَذُّ لَهُ نَشِيدِي، وَأَنَا أَفْرَحُ بِٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
verses.web: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.

verses.ar: لِتُبَدِ ٱلْخُطَاةُ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْأَشْرَارُ لَا يَكُونُوا بَعْدُ. بَارِكِي يَا نَفْسِي ٱلرَّبَّ. هَلِّلُويَا.
verses.kjv: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.web: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
